title: Pull-away hesitation and removed controls
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe hesitation or dead spots when pulling away, while a separate set mentions features or physical controls being taken away.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on sluggish or awkward pull-away response, lag at junctions or parking speeds, and frustration with buttons or functions moved into the screen or removed.

mixed.summary: The mixed feedback notes annoyance that features such as dual heating have been taken away.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention suddenness, hesitation, smoother pull-away versus the prior generation, removed items, and other safety or traction concerns, but the examples are too varied to support a clearer single sentiment reading.

limitations: This cluster mixes at least two subjects: pull-away driving behavior and items or controls being taken away.
Undetermined examples dominate and several are ambiguous or context-limited, so the topic's overall meaning is not fully consistent.
The provided examples are stratified samples and are not representative estimates of all reviews.
